p.src: 1  By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

en: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
u.src: 1  By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

p.src: 2  On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.

en: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.
u.src: 2  On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.

p.src: 3  For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”

en: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”
u.src: 3  For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”

p.src: 4  How can we sing the LORD’s song in a foreign land?

en: How can we sing the LORD’s song in a foreign land?
u.src: 4  How can we sing the LORD’s song in a foreign land?

p.src: 5  If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.

en: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.
u.src: 5  If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.

p.src: 6  Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.

en: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.
u.src: 6  Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.

p.src: 7  Remember, LORD, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”

en: Remember, LORD, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”
u.src: 7  Remember, LORD, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”

p.src: 8  Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.

en: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.
u.src: 8  Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.

p.src: 9  Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.

en: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.
u.src: 9  Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.
